title: Skills and loadouts
hook: **WIP:** equip a small set of **actions** — innate skills, family skills, signatures — with costs, cooldowns, and targeting. Not finished yet.

blindSpots.meaning: Not finished. You should not expect a full creature-sheet loadout editor as a daily loop yet.
The small set of actions on a creature — not a second character class.
Getting a skill is progression. It is not a second power curve beside levels and aptitudes.
Skills will spend [actor meters](actor-meters) you can see — when that loop lands.
Guard, movement skills, and reaction windows belong with meters and interactive battles — still WIP.

alsoTrue: Live power today is levels, traits, elements, and [aptitudes](aptitudes) — play those.
Hands-on turns that use skills: [interactive battles](interactive-battles) (also WIP).

sections.title: Not finished yet
paras: Loadouts will live on the creature sheet.
Until the editor and spend loop ship, treat missing skill slots as unfinished work.

sections.title: Design shape
sections.intro: What the page is aiming at:

cards.name: Innate
cards.body: Actions the creature brings by nature.

cards.name: Family
cards.body: Actions shared by a kinship of species.

cards.name: Signatures
cards.body: Standout actions that define the specimen’s face.

diagram: unlock skill (progression)  ->  equip on sheet  ->  spend meters / cooldown in fight
sections.note: Unlocking is progression — not a parallel grind that replaces levels.

sections.title: What you do today
paras: Raise specimens, field elements, and fight with the combat language that already ships.
Read this page so the future sheet vocabulary is not a surprise.

doTitle: What you do while it is WIP
doSteps: Grow roster power with levels, fusion, and aptitudes now.
When loadout UI appears, equip a small set — do not hunt for a class pick.
Treat skill unlocks as progression steps, not a second curve to max first.
doNote: Meters that pay costs: [actor meters](actor-meters). Specimen home: [specimens](specimens).

mixUps.q: Where is the skill loadout screen?
mixUps.a: WIP — not finished. Absence is expected.

mixUps.q: Is unlocking a skill a second power ladder?
mixUps.a: No. Design says unlocks are progression, not a second curve.

mixUps.q: Do I pick a class for skills?
mixUps.a: No. You have no class. Loadouts sit on the creature.
No. They spend meters and use the existing combat language.
No. Expeditions can stay auto-resolve; skills matter most when you pilot turns.
